label: ThinkPad L14 Gen 5 14-inch laptop
description: 14-inch Core Ultra (Series 1) volume business laptop. Networking is an onboard RJ-45 at Gigabit Ethernet (Intel I219-LM on vPro models, I219-V otherwise, Wake-on-LAN) plus Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX211 2x2 with Bluetooth 5.3, or the optional Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE200 2x2 with Bluetooth 5.4. WWAN tops out at 4G LTE (Quectel EM061K-GL Cat6 or EM160R-GL Cat16, eSIM) - no 5G option. Ports: 1x RJ-45, 1x Thunderbolt 4, 1x USB-C 20 Gbps, 2x USB-A 5 Gbps, HDMI, nano-SIM on WWAN models.
notes: Same 1 GbE RJ-45 as the T14 Gen 5 but a weaker WWAN story: PSREF lists 4G LTE Cat6/Cat16 only and 'upgradable to 4G', so do not model 5G on this chassis. Wi-Fi is AX211 6E by default, BE200 Wi-Fi 7 optional.
